inheritance: All canonical Japan38 discrete histories, the source-balanced Japan7 colour stop rule, global-to-local colour claim boundaries, FDT1 calibration evidence, and the unresolved absolute-time gate remain in force unless explicitly updated below.

orientation.current_decision: Do not map an orientation adaptation to a named Japan38 branch until transition placement improves. Use functional effects only to define what a future focal manipulation must measure.

phyllary_posture.current_decision: JPN36 is the strongest current ancestry-aware phyllary experiment target, but external bract manipulations are nonhomologous analogs and do not establish Cirsium phyllary adaptation.

stickiness.current_decision: JPN06 and JPN36 are high-information tests because benefit, null and cost models make opposing predictions; do not assign a universal sticky-is-defence coefficient.

colour.current_decision: No further sampling or reprocessing solely to rescue the anti-phylogenetic lightness hypothesis. Colour remains available for independent functional, discrete-state, molecular or field questions.

execution_order.first: Validate observed phyllary and stickiness states for JPN36 and stickiness for JPN06, then assess field/manipulation feasibility. These are the highest-information focal systems because transition localization and competing functional models overlap.
execution_order.second: Repair missing primary trait states: JPN34 orientation, JPN15 phyllary posture, JPN24 stickiness. Recompute histories after those states are added before selecting any new branch-specific targets.
execution_order.third: For orientation, add branch-localization evidence before ancestry-specific adaptive tests; meanwhile use the existing pollination/protection/net-fitness calibration to preregister mediator and fitness endpoints.
execution_order.fourth: For JPN36/JPN06 focal tests, measure mediator and final fitness jointly: enemy access/damage, pollinator access/effective transfer where relevant, and mature/viable seed output. For stickiness, include a cost axis rather than assuming defence benefit.
execution_order.fifth: Only after these focal functional contrasts are established should FDT4/FDT7 connect transition histories to niche regimes or simulations. Absolute-time FDT5/FDT6 remains conditional on the dating gate.

do_not_repeat: Do not resume colour sampling merely to obtain a negative anti-phylogenetic rho.
Do not pool orientation, phyllary and stickiness into one common effect size.
Do not treat Pedicularis bracts as homologous Cirsium phyllaries or Bejaria/Datura as a transported Cirsium stickiness effect.
Do not label JPN36 orientation as a transition target from the current history because no orientation ML edge is individually forced.
Do not call the absence of common-lability overlap proof of developmental or genetic modular evolvability.
claim_boundary: Readiness and experiment-prioritization contract only. Repeated-state histories plus external functional calibrations generate discriminating hypotheses, not adaptation claims. Functional homology, branch-specific selection, niche coupling, timing and molecular mechanism each require separate evidence gates.
